text:
```yaml
name: Tag Report

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          files: coverage.out

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.55

      - name: Run go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Generate tag report
        run: |
          echo "Tag report:" > tag_report.txt
          git tag -l | sort >> tag_report.txt
          cat tag_report.txt

      - name: Upload tag report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tag-report
          path: tag_report.txt

      - name: Create tag
        if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'Release v0.9.1')
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a v0.9.1 -m "Release v0.9.1"
          git push origin v0.9.1

      - name: Create GitHub release
        if: contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'Release v0.9.1')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v0.9.1
          name: Release v0.9.1
          body: |
            ## 🎉 Release v0.9.1

            **Version**: v0.9.1  
            **Type**: Patch (Bug Fix + Enhancement)  
            **Date**: 2025-10-30

            ### ✨ What's New

            #### Features
            - **Automatic UV Tool Cache Refresh** (SPEC-UPDATE-CACHE-FIX-001)
              - Auto-detects stale PyPI metadata
              - Seamlessly retries upgrade after cache clear
              - Users no longer need to run upgrade twice

            #### Bug Fixes  
            - Fixed double-run issue in `uv tool upgrade moai-adk`
            - Python 3.13 CI/CD workflow compatibility

            #### Documentation
            - Added troubleshooting guide (README)
            - Release notes in CHANGELOG
            - Complete SPEC documentation

            ### 📊 Quality Metrics
            - ✅ Tests: 572 passing
            - ✅ Coverage: 56.76%
            - ✅ Type Check: Passed
            - ✅ Security: No vulns
            - ✅ TAGs: 13 verified (100% integrity)

            ### 📦 Installation
            [code omitted]
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
